attach_huggingface_oauth: attach OAuth endpoints to a FastAPI app to enable Hugging Face OAuth login
parse_huggingface_oauth: parse OAuth info from a FastAPI request and return the logged-in user's OAuthInfo or None
create_oauth_info: create an OAuthInfo dataclass with access token, expiration, user info, state, and scope
create_oauth_user_info: create an OAuthUserInfo dataclass with user profile fields and organization memberships
create_oauth_org_info: create an OAuthOrgInfo dataclass with org identity and security restriction fields
